settings.aboutText:
Nourish & Flow was born from a simple but powerful idea: that wellness isn't a destination, it's a daily practice. It lives in the way your body moves, the food you prepare with care, and the choices you make for yourself every single day.

We are Nasya and Citra: two women, two disciplines, one shared vision. Together, we created a space where strength meets softness, and where nourishment isn't just about what's on your plate, but how fully you inhabit your life.
settings.aboutQuote: We don't just teach wellness. We live it, and we want you to live it too.
settings.aboutWhyText: We don't believe in punishing routines or restrictive diets. We believe in movement that feels liberating, food that feels joyful, and a wellness journey that's entirely, unapologetically yours. Queer-friendly, body-positive and made for women travelers and locals alike. Based in Bali, we weave the island's spirit of balance into everything we do.
settings.bodyByline: With Nasya, pole dance artist & Pilates instructor
settings.bodyIntro: Movement is medicine. Whether you come for the pole, the mat, or the stage, every session with Nasya is designed to help you feel stronger, freer, and more at home in your own skin.
settings.plateIntro: Good food doesn't have to be complicated, but it does have to be intentional. Citra's offerings are designed for people who want to eat well without obsessing over every bite, and feel the difference that real, thoughtful nutrition makes.
settings.shopIntro: Book a class, reserve a workshop, or order from our kitchen. Everything goes through WhatsApp or secure payment links: quick and personal.

settings.connectQuote: Your wellness journey starts with one step, or one meal. We're here for both.

services.name: Pole Dance Classes
services.shortDescription: This isn't a showgirl class, it's a strength class. Build real strength and confidence on the pole.
services.description:
This isn't a showgirl class: it's a strength class. Nasya's pole dance sessions are built around the philosophy of empowerment: learning to trust your body, build genuine physical strength, and move with confidence you carry long after you leave the studio.

Open to complete beginners through to advanced students. No experience, no perfect body type, no prerequisites. Just you and your willingness to try something transformative.

Plans are personalised based on your dietary needs, fitness goals, and food preferences. Delivered fresh in Bali on a weekly basis.

Can't make it to Bali? Bring Citra's kitchen to yours. Her downloadable recipe collections are packed with nutrient-dense, flavour-forward meals that work for busy schedules, high-performance lifestyles, and plant-based living.

Each recipe comes with full nutritional breakdowns, easy-to-source ingredients, and prep tips so you can eat like a nutritionist without the guesswork.

More than just cooking: Citra's workshops are an education in how food works for your body. Learn how to build balanced, high-performance meals, understand macros without the obsession, and walk away with the knowledge and recipes to transform the way you eat.

Held in Bali in intimate group settings. Perfect for wellness seekers, fitness lovers, and anyone ready to take their relationship with food to the next level.

team.name: Nasya
team.bio:
Nasya is a pole dance artist and Pilates instructor who believes that movement is one of the most powerful forms of self-expression. Her approach to pole dance isn't about performance for others: it's about rediscovering your own strength, grace, and confidence from the inside out.

Whether you're stepping onto the pole for the first time or deepening your Pilates practice, Nasya creates a space that is welcoming, empowering, and free from judgment. Every class is an invitation to reconnect with your body on your own terms.

team.name: Citra
team.bio:
Citra is a nutritionist chef who understands that what you eat shapes not just your body, but your energy, your mood, and your entire relationship with food. With expertise in fitness nutrition and plant-based cooking, she crafts meals and recipes that are as satisfying as they are nourishing.

From customised weekly meal plans for gym enthusiasts to vibrant vegan menus and hands-on cooking workshops, Citra's philosophy is simple: food should be your greatest ally, not your greatest source of stress.
